blockers.verbatim_goal: Define G.fwdLive t chi, the forward-live positions at slice t: the greatest set X of positions such that from every position of X there is a succP-path inside X discharging each eventuality pending at it. Implement as a decreasing Finset iteration whose inner reachability step is the least fixpoint AUFix.lfp.
blockers.what_was_tried: The position space, succP/predP and the Q5 factorization were all landed first (15.1) so that 15.2 would have every ingredient. AUFix was read and confirmed generic and reusable; the probe TypePreservingPaste.lean was transcribed with no added hypothesis.
blockers.why_it_failed: Not attempted, deliberately, because the definition as the plan states it is not well posed. posAt and succP are slice-indexed, so fwdLive t at an arbitrary t : Z is a Z-indexed FAMILY of Finsets, not one Finset, and a decreasing iteration on a family does not terminate for the reason a decreasing iteration on one Finset does. What makes it finite is the eventual periodicity of G.slice, and turning that into a computation is exactly what Phase 16's Phi_back / Phi_fwd and tailStable_iff_window are for -- so the Phase 15 / Phase 16 boundary is probably in the wrong place. The full argument and two candidate resolutions are recorded under the plan's Phase 15 heading. Writing a definition before that decision is taken would have produced either a non-terminating iteration or a silently weaker theorem.

blockers.target: PlusSlicedCertificate.succP non-emptiness on the position space
blockers.verbatim_goal: Prove succP and predP are non-empty on the position space, from G.BiSerial and the type-completion argument. Without this the fixpoints are vacuous.
blockers.what_was_tried: The construction was attempted and a counterexample was found instead: with untl g e in the closure, g and e both atoms, and a certificate whose slice labelling carries no atom, X = {untl g e} is a legitimate member of posAt t with no successor, because every successor label must also carry no atom and the untl clause then demands untl g e not-in X.
blockers.why_it_failed: The obligation is FALSE as stated, and the parenthetical worry is mistaken too: successor-less positions are exactly what the GREATEST fixpoint fwdLive exists to discard. Replaced, not dropped, by mem_succP_of_path and mem_predP_of_path, both proved: every position a genuine locally-coherent labelled path visits has that path's own next (resp. previous) position as a witness, which is all the fixpoints need. Recorded in Position.lean's module header and in the plan's Phase 15 deviations. A machine-checked #eval witness is flagged as not landed rather than concealed.
